title: Cognito prefix swap fails if the user pool already has a domain: delete the old domain first
description: Found 2026-10-12. Applying cms.cognitoDomainPrefix (PAPYRUS_APPLY_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX=true) on a pool that already has a hosted-UI domain fails: Cognito allows one domain per pool and cannot rename it. The template should detect an existing different domain and delete it (briefly breaking hosted sign-in) before creating the new one in the same custom resource, or document the manual order (delete the domain, then deploy). Related: 72c01d.
right_now_summary: The template must delete the old Cognito domain before creating the new one.
